purpose: Canonical learning writeback after the Powerhouse One Loop implementation, recovery, protected merges, production readbacks, obligation sweeps and terminal learning closure completed successfully.
learnings: Terminal delivery is not complete at merge. Completion requires exact-head gates, protected merge, current-main readback, production/runtime evidence where applicable, obligation reconciliation, learning writeback and cleanup evidence.

A later same-obligation commit after an apparent terminal merge must first be classified by scope and lineage. A bounded learning-only successor can be legitimate closure continuation rather than parallel implementation drift.
Canonical learning state is part of production truth. Stale IMPLEMENTING or unresolved learning records keep the system non-terminal even when runtime behavior is already proven.
Post-merge Outcome Obligation Sweep on the actual current main is the final reconciliation proof that no new obligation or evidence gap was introduced by the closure writeback itself.
Open-PR search for the same obligation is a required anti-shadow-state check before declaring closure.
Exact-head identity remains the only promotion authority. Superseded failures are historical evidence, never mutation or merge authority.
A recovery must preserve the same causal lineage and repair only proven root cause. No parallel branch or PR may become a competing source of truth for the same obligation.
Learning writeback is not documentation after the fact; it is an executable control-plane input for future existing-state-first decisions.
permanent_prevention_rules: EXISTING_STATE_FIRST: every agent or chat must read canonical Powerhouse state and relevant lineage before acting.
ONE_OBLIGATION_ONE_EXECUTABLE_CANDIDATE: never create competing implementation or recovery candidates for the same obligation.
NO_TERMINAL_STATUS_ON_MERGE_ALONE: merged, committed, queued, timed out or chat-stopped are not terminal states.
TERMINAL_CLOSURE_REQUIRES_CURRENT_MAIN_READBACK: after every closure merge, reread current main and the canonical learning artifacts before declaring LIVE & BEWEZEN.
POST_CLOSURE_SWEEP_REQUIRED: the post-merge Outcome Obligation Sweep for the final current-main SHA must be successful.
NO_SHADOW_PR_AFTER_CLOSURE: search for open same-obligation PRs and reconcile or close them before terminal closure.
SAME_OBLIGATION_SUCCESSOR_CLASSIFICATION: if main moves again for the same obligation, inspect changed scope and evidence before treating the movement as drift.
LEARNING_IS_DOD: root cause, evidence, outcome and prevention rules must be written back canonically before the obligation is considered fulfilled.
TERMINAL_HISTORY_IS_IMMUTABLE: a fulfilled historical checkpoint is reopened only by new concrete regression evidence; otherwise future work starts from that checkpoint.
RECOVERY_IS_AUTONOMOUS: recoverable incomplete states resume from the last proven checkpoint without waiting for a new human instruction.

future_agent_starting_point.instruction: Reuse this terminal checkpoint. Do not redesign or recreate the One Loop mechanisms unless new evidence proves a regression or missing capability.
required_preflight: check for an already-active obligation/candidate before creating work
